svg.title: Through a Glass, Darkly
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Luke 9:28-29, 32): Jesus standing in prayer on a mountain while Peter, James and John lie asleep on the ground nearby. Caption: "On the mountain. Jesus is praying." Luke says: "Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep". Panel 2 (Luke 9:29-32): Jesus shining white between Moses and Elijah, with Peter, James and John kneeling, now awake, in front of Him. Caption: "Moses and Elijah appear in glory." Luke says: "but when they became fully awake they saw his glory". Panel 3 (Luke 9:34-35): a cloud over the mountain and the three disciples kneeling, afraid, as a voice speaks from the cloud. Caption: "A cloud overshadows them." A voice from the cloud says: "This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!" Panel 4 (Luke 9:36): Jesus standing alone on the mountain with the three disciples before Him. Caption: "The voice falls silent." Luke says: "Jesus was found alone." Panel 5 (2 Peter 1:16, 19): Peter, older, holding a scroll beside a burning lamp in a dark room. Caption: "Years later, Peter writes to you." Peter says: "you will do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns". The point: Now you see Jesus in the mirror of the gospel, and every glimpse is His gift. Wake, look to Him, and wait: then you will see Him face to face (1 Corinthians 13:12).
svg.text: Heavy with sleep, and then they saw His glory

g.text: On the mountain. Jesus is praying.

svg.text: Now you see Jesus in the mirror of the gospel, and every
glimpse is His gift. Wake, look to Him, and wait: then
you will see Him face to face (1 Corinthians 13:12).
Luke is the gospel that records the three heavy with sleep on the mountain (Luke 9:32).
